import {
  LayoutDashboard, Users, Building2, GitBranch, Briefcase,
  Package, FileText, Bell, BarChart2, ArrowLeftRight,
  TrendingUp, UserCheck, Shield,
} from 'lucide-react';

export const ROUTES = {
  LOGIN: '/login',
  DASHBOARD: '/dashboard',
  EMPLOYEES: '/employees',
  DEPARTMENTS: '/departments',
  BRANCHES: '/branches',
  DESIGNATIONS: '/designations',
  ASSETS: '/assets',
  DOCUMENTS: '/documents',
  TRANSFERS: '/transfers',
  PROMOTIONS: '/promotions',
  ONBOARDING: '/onboarding',
  NOTIFICATIONS: '/notifications',
  REPORTS: '/reports',
  ROLES: '/roles',
};

// Single source of truth for sidebar nav — consumed by Sidebar.js and AppLayout.js
export const NAV_ITEMS = [
  { to: ROUTES.DASHBOARD,    icon: LayoutDashboard, labelKey: 'nav.dashboard' },
  { to: ROUTES.EMPLOYEES,    icon: Users,           labelKey: 'nav.employees' },
  { to: ROUTES.DEPARTMENTS,  icon: Building2,       labelKey: 'nav.departments' },
  { to: ROUTES.BRANCHES,     icon: GitBranch,       labelKey: 'nav.branches' },
  { to: ROUTES.DESIGNATIONS, icon: Briefcase,       labelKey: 'nav.designations' },
  { to: ROUTES.ASSETS,       icon: Package,         labelKey: 'nav.assets' },
  { to: ROUTES.DOCUMENTS,    icon: FileText,        labelKey: 'nav.documents' },
  { to: ROUTES.TRANSFERS,    icon: ArrowLeftRight,  labelKey: 'nav.transfers' },
  { to: ROUTES.PROMOTIONS,   icon: TrendingUp,      labelKey: 'nav.promotions' },
  { to: ROUTES.ONBOARDING,   icon: UserCheck,       labelKey: 'nav.onboarding' },
  { to: ROUTES.NOTIFICATIONS,icon: Bell,            labelKey: 'nav.notifications' },
  { to: ROUTES.REPORTS,      icon: BarChart2,       labelKey: 'nav.reports' },
  { to: ROUTES.ROLES,        icon: Shield,          labelKey: 'nav.roles' },
];
